name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2021-02-22.163.1) introduced by WA Senator [Glenn Sterle](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/wa/glenn_sterle) (Labor) to refer this [bill](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r6440) to the [Rural and Regional Affairs and Transport Legislation Committee](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Rural_and_Regional_Affairs_and_Transport), which means it was successful. ### Motion text > *That this bill be referred to the Senate Rural and Regional Affairs and Transport Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 11 March 2021.*
